tool_recommendations:
Recommended CAD MCP tools for: # Live AutoCAD demo prompt

Use the `precise_draw_from_spec` workflow with the active AutoCAD session.

Create a production-style A3 landscape mechanical assembly drawing titled
`BOLTED FLANGE COUPLING ASSEMBLY`. Use millimetres, draw model-space geometry
at true 1:1 size, and apply the repository's generic mechanical assembly
practice without claiming ISO, GB, ASME, or other formal drawing compliance.

Show:

- a longitudinal half-section main view, an aligned end view, and a compact
  exploded assembly schematic;
- two flanged hubs, two diameter-40 shafts, and two 12 x 8 x 70 parallel keys;
- four equally spaced M12 bolt sets on a diameter-90 bolt circle;
- flange outside diameter 120, hub outside diameter 65, flange thickness 16,
  and hub length 50;
- centerlines, true dimension entities, and differentiated section hatching;
- an eight-item BOM with item number, part number, description, quantity,
  material/specification, and remarks;
- matching item leaders outside the assembly outline;
- an A3 border, title block, revision field, units, scale, projection method,
  author/checker fields, and concise assembly notes.

Reuse suitable existing styles when present. Use arrays for repeated fasteners.
Use real dimensions, a real CAD table, real hatches, and real multileaders; do
not fake those semantics with loose text and linework.

Before editing, inspect the active document, active space, and units. Build
bounded CADPlan phases, validate each phase, and dry-run it. The user has
authorized creation of a new blank drawing and transactional modification of
that demo drawing, plus saving and exporting only to this example's documented
paths. After execution, rescan, build CAD-IR, detect mechanical semantics, bind
dimensions, extract and check constraints, validate geometry, and export both
a clean view and a mapped overlay. Repair at most two visually confirmed
issues, then save the DWG and review exports.

Workflow route:
- Existing or complex drawing understanding
  -> inspect document, active space, units, and a visual baseline when useful
  -> scan_all_entities(topology_detail='summary'); escalate to full only after local handle evidence is insufficient
  -> build_drawing_ir(sections=['overview', 'entities'] for orientation and handle lookup)
  -> summarize_drawing
  -> analyze_drawing_intent
  -> detect_semantic_objects(domain='mechanical' or another suitable domain)
  -> bind_all_dimensions -> extract_drawing_constraints -> check_drawing_constraints
  -> validate_geometry
  -> render_drawing_view when the model must see; export_view_image_with_mapping with tiles when grounding is needed
  Fidelity: Keep uncertain semantics explicit; do not collapse views, dimensions, BOMs, title blocks, or section/detail views into generic linework.
  Fidelity: Use CAD-IR resources and semantic graph evidence before editing or summarizing a dense drawing.
- New complex drawing from specification
  -> inspect units, model-space true size, viewport/paper/annotation scales, layers, and styles
  -> recommend_cad_tools(intent) to identify purpose-built tools
  -> define plan-external acceptance criteria, then create CADPlan with variables, layers, save_as handles, dependencies, step expect metadata, and executable postconditions
  -> validate_cad_plan -> dry_run_cad_plan
  -> execute_cad_plan with allow_modify=True and transactional=True when permission is present
  -> scan_all_entities -> build_drawing_ir -> bind/check -> validate_geometry -> render_drawing_view
  Fidelity: Use blocks/arrays for repeated components, CAD tables for BOMs, dimensions for measurements, hatches for sections, and solids/booleans for 3D intent.
  Fidelity: If no exposed tool can preserve a requested feature, state the limitation instead of silently simplifying it.

Tool matches:
1. detect_semantic_objects [Understanding]
   Use: Detect domain-level objects such as parts, holes, labels, dimensions, tables, views, and drawing regions.
   Avoid: Do not flatten meaningful CAD objects into anonymous lines and text.
2. analyze_engineering_drawing_stages [Engineering review]
   Use: Analyze layout segmentation, annotations, title blocks, BOM-like tables, VLM parsing, and semantic reconciliation.
   Avoid: Do not simplify engineering sheets to one model-space outline when views and annotations carry meaning.
3. dry_run_cad_plan [CADPlan]
   Use: Dry-run a CADPlan to inspect planned operations and handle bindings without modifying AutoCAD.
   Avoid: Do not skip dry-run for multi-step generation or repair.
4. check_drawing_constraints [Understanding]
   Use: Check extracted constraints against current geometry and report violations.
   Avoid: Do not repair design-intent issues without checking the active constraint set.
5. export_view_image [Vision verification]
   Use: Export the current AutoCAD view as a model-facing review image artifact without modifying the DWG.
   Avoid: Do not rely only on database scans when a vision-capable model needs to verify the visible drawing state.
6. prepare_visual_semantic_context [Image trace]
   Use: Build VLM-friendly artifacts and an open-vocabulary component hypothesis contract before asking a vision model to identify mechanical parts.
   Avoid: Do not force exact part names from a partial or sectioned view without evidence and missing_evidence.
7. scan_all_entities [Query]
   Use: Scan an existing drawing into SQLite before analysis or edits. Default scans are lightweight but still derive topology summaries; use topology_detail='full' for primitive/relation topology.
   Avoid: Do not edit an unknown existing drawing without surveying handles first.
8. render_drawing_view [Visual grounding]
   Use: Render the current AutoCAD view and SEE it inline (export + image content in one call) so a vision-capable model can verify drawing state after edits.
   Avoid: Do not edit blind; do not add visible helper geometry to inspect the drawing.
9. add_table [Annotation]
   Use: Create a CAD table for schedules, BOMs, part lists, or notes.
   Avoid: Do not build tables from many lines and text entities.
10. compile_image_spec_to_cad_plan [Image trace]
   Use: Compile ImageDrawingSpec/v1 to a guarded CADPlan without modifying the DWG.
   Avoid: Do not directly draw from pixels without CADPlan validation and dry-run.
11. extract_drawing_constraints [Understanding]
   Use: Extract geometric and dimensional constraints such as alignment, symmetry, spacing, and measurement intent.
   Avoid: Do not move or redraw constrained geometry before checking design intent.
12. add_hatch [Hatch and fill]
   Use: Create hatch/fill, then add boundaries with hatch_add_boundary.
   Avoid: Do not imitate fill with dense parallel lines.

Workflow guards:
- Existing drawing: scan_all_entities -> get_entity_statistics/execute_query before edits.
- Vision-capable model: call render_drawing_view (or get_snapshot_image) to SEE the drawing inline whenever the visible CAD state needs confirmation; use view_image to see a source/reference file.
- Dense/complex drawing: use CAD-IR, semantic objects, constraints, validation, and overlay mapping before simplifying.
- New complex drawing: use CADPlan validation and dry-run before execution.
- Model-only context: use add_spatial_annotation/list_spatial_annotations instead of drawing helper labels.
- Prefer named tools over draw_line/draw_circle/draw_polyline and repeated copy_entity.
- Use send_command only after the catalog has no suitable tool.
- Capture returned handles; most edits and dimensions need handles.
